Subject: a THREE-PANEL horizontal strip, three equal panels in one row separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders or frame lines. One consistent world and cast across all three panels: a middle-aged woman real-estate agent with short curly dark hair streaked grey, wearing a rust-colored cardigan, in a small warm home office. The glowing translucent amber laptop is the same laptop in panels two and three.

PANEL ONE (setup): the woman sits at her desk, shoulders tense, arms folded, turned AWAY from her laptop, which is CLOSED and dim on the desk. Above and behind her, a drift of grey newspaper pages with heavy dark headline bars looms like a cloud. Her face is worried. Nothing glows.

PANEL TWO (consequence): outside on the street in the same neighborhood. A client (a tall man in a long charcoal coat) is walking AWAY from the woman, who stands small in the background at her office doorway. The client walks TOWARD a rival agent, an older man in an olive sweater, who holds an OPEN glowing translucent amber laptop; the screen faces the RIVAL, so we see the laptop's warm glow spilling around its lid. The rival hands the client a beautiful bound presentation booklet with a house pictured on its cover; the client reaches for it. The exchange happens between rival and client only; the woman touches nothing in this panel.

PANEL THREE (resolution): back at her desk, the same woman now leans IN toward the SAME amber laptop, now OPEN and facing HER, its glow warm on her face. INSIDE the screen, two small rounded software agents assemble a tidy presentation of houses. Her hand points at one house card on the screen in a correcting gesture, mid-judgment. Beside the desk stands a happy client (a young woman with box braids, mustard scarf) holding the finished bound presentation booklet against her chest. The booklet in her hands matches the presentation on the screen.
